title: Three 20-Minute Vegan Meals for Beginners: Tacos, Creamy Tomato Pasta, and Chickpea-Broccoli Sesame Rice Bowl

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.basis: Transcript line 00:00:00 explicitly states 'i'm cooking in the kitchen'

summary: This Goodful video features two hosts guiding a beginner vegan through three fast, 20-minute meals: vegan tacos with crumbled tofu and a quick chipotle crema, a creamy one-pot tomato pasta seasoned with a paprika-like blend and enhanced with nutrition yeast, and a chickpea–broccoli sesame rice bowl with a glossy sauce. The presenters emphasize simple, plant-based substitutions (onion powder instead of onions, almond milk, vegan mayo and sour cream, nutritional yeast) and practical assembly tips (bottom-layer sauce in tacos, batch-friendly prep, and a takeout-inspired vibe). Interwoven with cooking, they discuss motivations for going vegan and the challenges of a 30-day transition, ending with a channel plug for Joyce’s vegan journey. The result is a beginner-friendly, time-conscious collection of recipes that showcase flavor, texture, and plant-based substitutions suitable for new vegans or curious cooks.
